entities.summary: Paul Landers (b. 1964-12-09, Treptow-Köpenick) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Treptow-Köpenick. Known in the fields of composers & musicians.
